map.Q 越高代表什么？: What Does a High Q Represent?
map.Q 高表示损耗小、谐振尖锐、选频能力强，但带宽窄。: A high Q means low loss, a sharp resonance and strong frequency selectivity, but a narrow bandwidth.
map.Q 与带宽关系？: What's the Relation Between Q and Bandwidth?
map.Q = f0/BW，二者成反比，高 Q 必窄带。: Q = f0/BW, the two are inversely proportional, so a high Q necessarily means a narrow band.
